body:
# Baston's Coordinates

A modern, minimalist coordinates HUD for Fabric — inspired by **Batty's
Coordinates PLUS**, the beloved 1.12.2 mod that never got updated.

Rebuilt from scratch for Minecraft **26.1.2** and entirely configurable
through **Mod Menu** — no keybinds to memorize, no clutter, just the
information you actually want on screen.

![In-game HUD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1mscbQqf/images/225c0aca113244fd8552f96a735cc7eb04bbead5.png)

## ✨ Features

- **XYZ coordinates** with separate colours for positive and negative
  values
- **Compass cardinal** — N / NE / E / SE / S / SW / W / NW
- **Movement arrows** — chevrons (`+` / `-`) on the X and Z lines indicate
  which way the coords are changing as you walk
- **Player head** rendered next to the compass — face *and* hat overlay,
  using the same helper Minecraft uses for the multiplayer tab list
- **Local time** — real-world clock on its own row, `HH:mm` or `HH:mm:ss`
- **Independent FPS panel** that auto-stacks below the coords when both
  share a corner
- **Auto-hides** when the F3 debug overlay is open — no double-up of info
- **Dynamic panel width** that only grows as wide as the active features
  need (with a configurable floor)

## 🎨 Customization

Open **Mod Menu** → click the gear next to *Baston's Coordinates*.

### Coordinates Panel
- Toggle every individual feature (compass, arrows, time, player head…)
- Choose a screen corner (Top Left / Top Right / Bottom Right)
- Fine-tune position with X / Y offset sliders
- Set a minimum panel width floor

### FPS Panel
- Independent on/off and screen corner
- When in the same corner as the coords panel, the FPS auto-stacks below
  (or above for bottom corners) with a configurable gap

### Colours
- **R / G / B sliders** with a live preview swatch for every text element
- **RGBA** for the background — full transparency control

The HUD renders on top of the config screen so you can preview your
changes immediately after clicking *Save & Quit*.

## 📦 Requirements

| Requirement       | Version            |
|-------------------|--------------------|
| Minecraft         | `26.1.2`           |
| Fabric Loader     | `0.19.3+`          |
| Fabric API        | any matching build |
| Java              | `25+`              |

### Optional but strongly recommended
- [**Mod Menu**](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) — entry point for the
  config screen
- [**Cloth Config**](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) — provides the
  config UI widgets

Without these the mod still works, just with defaults. You can edit the
file at `config/bastons_coordinates.properties` manually.
